VLT is the share of visible light that passes through the film. Lower numbers are darker. Heat rejection comes from the film tier, not the darkness.

Visible light transmission (VLT)

Below 70% VLT, front windows may not meet minimums in some provinces. We’ll confirm compliant options for your vehicle and region before install.
